T&Cs
Each passenger is allowed to purchase a maximum of one liquor item.
Liquor will not be available for Child, Infant, Extra Seat, and Stretcher PAX types.
Liquor SSR is currently available for International flights to/from BOM, IXE, HYD, and BLR.
Liquor is restricted on all flights from anywhere to Saudi Arabia; however, it is available on all flights from Saudi Arabia to anywhere.
Pre-book Alcohol Cut-off Time is 48 hours before departure.
